## Problem

What are you trying to do that the portal makes hard or impossible today?
Concrete workflows beat abstract wishes.

## Proposed solution

How you imagine it working. Rough is fine.

## Alternatives

Workarounds you use now, or other ways this could be solved (including
"an existing feature almost does this").
